d: Short, platinum white hair is styled in a voluminous, choppy crop with thick bangs sweeping across the forehead. The eyes are a piercing crimson red with a sharp, focused expression, set on a youthful face with an adolescent maturity. A slender build is dressed in an oversized black hooded garment featuring a wide, draped silhouette, a black-and-grey patterned inner lining, and silver stud accents along the hem and sleeves. Signature details include a black choker with a red gem, a pink bubblegum bubble at the mouth, and a large, serrated metallic scythe with a red-glowing blade.
